howToPlay: Keep your distance from enemies to maximize damage with your pressure rockets at long range. Utilize the Disengage gadget to escape tight situations or the Finish Them gadget to secure kills on low health targets.
gears: Equip Damage to boost your attack power when health is low, Shield to increase your overall durability, or Speed to move faster in bushes.
trait: This marksman suits players who excel at long-range positioning and strategic resource management.
